gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma with definitive resection prior to enrollment

candidate_evidence.quote: Varlilumab is an agonist anti-CD27 monoclonal antibody

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma will be consented following tumor resection

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Treg determined by flow cytometry (CD3+ CD4+ CD25+ Foxp3+).

role_evidence.quote: Varlilumab is an agonist anti-CD27 monoclonal antibody

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: CD27 agonism depleting regulatory T cells and improving antitumour immunity

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide is a standard chemotherapy given to all enrolled patients

agents.agent_name_registered: Human CMV pp65-LAMP mRNA-pulsed autologous DCs

role_evidence.quote: human CMV pp65-LAMP mRNA-pulsed autologous DCs are given intradermally and bilaterally at the groin site
autologous unpulsed DCs in saline administered to a single side of the groin intradermally 1 day before the fourth vaccine

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell therapy used as pre-conditioning

role_evidence.quote: A single dose of Td toxoid (1 flocculation unit, Lf, in 0.4 mLs) administered to a single side of the groin given intradermally

agents.drug_class_hint: tetanus-diphtheria toxoid vaccine used as vaccine-site pre-conditioning to promote DC migration

source_quote.quote: Enough tumor tissue available for determination of MGMT gene promoter status.

coder_notes: Varlilumab is the only investigational drug (Group 3); the dendritic cell vaccine, unpulsed DCs and Td toxoid are excluded intervention types. Td toxoid is investigational pre-conditioning to enhance DC migration, coded as excluded_intervention_type (vaccine); an adjudicator may prefer another role. MGMT: tissue must be available to determine status and unmethylated patients get only one adjuvant TMZ cycle; no specific status is required, so eligibility coding is debatable. Groups 1 and 2 act as controls for the Td and varlilumab questions.
